announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.2
announcements.body: The whole app speaks your language. Every screen, every menu and every warning is now in English, Portuguese or Spanish, chosen once and remembered. Technical words stay as they are, because an issue is called an issue wherever you work.

announcements.title: Live Coding: desenvolvendo com IA de forma guiada
announcements.body: Nesta call vamos desenvolver uma funcionalidade ao vivo no Nexus Studio: estruturar a ideia, criar as specs, organizar as tasks e guiar os agents durante todo o desenvolvimento. Na pratica, como manter contexto, arquitetura e controle sobre o codigo, sem depender de prompts soltos nem deixar a IA decidir tudo sozinha.
announcements.imageAlt: Live Coding: desenvolvendo com IA de forma guiada, com o board do Nexus Studio

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-8
announcements.body: A finished piece of development stops being reported as nothing. UX design draws the screens instead of only describing them, a workflow's choices arrive as buttons, an agent may no longer decide nobody is watching, and updating from the Debian package works.

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-7
announcements.body: See what your agents changed without leaving the app: the files, the diff, the history, and a commit you make yourself with a message Gil writes from the diff. Gil is the tenth agent. Two dashboards say where a project stands and which project needs you, an agent can draw you a mock before the work starts, and the method now follows the app when it updates.

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-6
announcements.body: The terminal opens your own, in the project folder, on every platform. Windows stops flashing black boxes and wears the right icon, and the Architecture column is gone from the board.

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-5
announcements.body: Work in two projects at once and neither goes quiet, an agent's findings become cards you can see, and the light theme is readable. A notification now makes a sound, which you can turn off.

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-4
announcements.body: Screenshots go into the project now: paste one where you are working, in a chat, an issue or a document. The message box also stays open while an agent runs, so what you type waits its turn instead of being lost.

announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-3
announcements.body: Codex works again: it was asking for a model it no longer has, so the run failed on its first turn. It now offers the models Codex actually has today. Linux receives automatic updates for the first time. A project no longer shows the runs of the one you had open before it, the Docs list fills in as the agent writes, and a note left for the agent stops being read as the document's first line.

announcements.title: Welcome to the first public build
announcements.body: Nexus Studio now updates itself. Downloads and release notes stay on the public releases page, and nothing about your projects leaves this machine.
